root_cause: get_parameterless_sub_dependant() (used for dependencies=[Depends(...)] on routes, routers and the app) called get_dependant(path, call, security_scopes) without forwarding depends.scope, so Depends(f, scope='function') at those levels fell back to the default 'request' scope and the yield-teardown ran after the response instead of before it.
best_solution: In fastapi/dependencies/utils.py get_parameterless_sub_dependant, pass scope=depends.scope into the get_dependant(...) call alongside path, call and security_scopes. get_dependant already accepts a scope kwarg (the parametered sub-dependency path already forwards it), so the parameterless path simply has to thread the same attribute through. With scope='function' the exit code after yield now runs inside the endpoint's exit stack, so an HTTPException raised after yield becomes a 503 response; with scope='request' it still runs after the response is sent (client sees 200).
acceptable_alternatives: Any call ordering of the kwargs; forwarding scope positionally is not possible (keyword-only). Nothing else needed.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_dependency_yield_scope.py adds test_router_level_dep_scope_function (include_router(dependencies=[Depends(raise_after_yield, scope='function')]) -> 503 {'detail': 'Exception after yield'}), test_router_level_dep_scope_request (-> 200 {'status': 'ok'} with raise_server_exceptions=False), test_app_level_dep_scope_function (FastAPI(dependencies=[...scope='function']) -> 503), test_app_level_dep_scope_request (-> 200). No new API; only behavior of existing Depends(scope=...).
locating_signals: Statement names the exact function get_parameterless_sub_dependant, the target get_dependant, and the missing attribute depends.scope. grep for get_parameterless_sub_dependant lands on the one-line fix.
our_outcome_summary: Solved by all: v4, v6, v7, v8 all pass in the Kaggle env (11 passed). v4/v6/v7 produced the identical one-line patch (scope=depends.scope appended to the get_dependant call), 36-83s, 12-22 calls. v8 made the same source fix plus an extra tests/test_issue_repro.py file (2064 chars, 51 calls, 111s); the extra test file was harmless but wasted calls.
generalizable_lesson: When a statement says a value 'is not forwarded/passed through' in a named helper, find that helper's call to the downstream function, compare its kwargs against sibling call sites that already forward the attribute, and add the one missing keyword; do not refactor or add repro test files once the one-line forward is in place.
